summary.text: John Kane represents Pennsylvania's 9th Senatorial District, serving Delaware and Chester Counties; he is a plumber and local labor leader.

paragraphs.text: After graduating from high school in Delaware County, Kane joined Plumbers Local 690, the union he represented as business manager for five terms, including through the Great Recession, which put nearly 500 members out of work.
He lives in Birmingham with his wife, Lori, and sits on the board of the Livengrin Foundation, which provides addiction treatment across southeastern Pennsylvania.
